venue.address: Skill Centre of Excellence, #300, 6th main, Arekere MICO Layout Stage 1, Bengaluru - 560076

items.information: Online registration ends on 28th December, 2017. On the spot registration is available. Visit [registration & payment tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BhejaFryYearEndOpen2017#3377-registration-payment) for more details. If you want to be a full-time volunteer mention it in the "Comment" section during registration. **First time participants** Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA Step 2 - Register for the competition Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the payments tab **Other participants** Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions Step 2 - Register for the competition (ensure your WCA id is mentioned) Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the payments tab The winner of MBLD event will be declared the competition winner.

items.name: Carolina Clock 'Stravaganza 2017
items.information: **Clock is the main event of this competition**, the winners of clock will be announced as the winners of the competition. There is no cutoff for clock, so everyone that would like to compete in clock may do so without any pressure. If you are thinking about registering, but feel the cutoffs are too strict, go ahead and register, and let the organization team know; we may be more lenient and adjust the cutoffs depending on the turnout. To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. Inproper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact the organizers to resolve the issue.

items.name: Malaysian Cube Championship 2017
items.information: Malaysian Cube Championship 2017 is opened to all nationalities, but only Malaysians are eligible to win the prizes. **Registration info** * Registration opens on Tuesday, 7th November, 8pm (GMT+8). * The steps for registration are as follows: 1. [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysianCubeChampionship2017/register) 2. [Pay](https://www.mycubeassociation.com/payment-malaysiancubechamp) according the the events you registered. 3. Once we have confirmed correct payment, we will accept your registration. **In order to complete your registration please proceed with the payment according to the events registered. Payment which does not match with the event registered will not be accepted and the payment will be refund.
